jobs.title: Group Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Opportunity: Group Analyst**

Group Analyst position is integral to the success of maximizing the Hotel’s revenues, budgets and forecasts. The primary purpose of this position is to support and liaison with sales, revenue management and operations departments. The position will be responsible for the preparation and analysis of incoming group leads, revenue reports that will assist the sales team in implementing the Hotel’s yield strategies. In addition, the Group Analyst will be required to review and analyze reports such as STAR, Hotel Intelligence and other measurement tools when presenting revenue opportunities for the hotel.

**Potential Career Path**

Revenue Manager – Area Sales Manager

**Essential Job Functions**

* Manage group lead process for the Sales Team: Evaluate incoming group leads and RFPs for a specific segment or group of hotels. Calculate and recommend optimal quotes based on historical data, displacement analysis, and current market demand.
* Attend DBR and quote leads that fall out of the established MARS.
* Manage and modify MAR Rates in the Sales System as required under the guidance of the Director of Sales and Revenue Manager to ensure optimal use by the sales team. Ensure the sales team is always equipped with accurate, up-to-date pricing floors.
* Assist Directors of Revenue Management and Directors of Sales in preparing for hotel forecast reporting.
* Support BT Sales with market analysis reporting as needed.
* Accurate preparation and distribution of sales and revenue reports. Reports may include market segmentation analysis, production reports, pace reports, group forecast reports, budget tools, etc.
* Perform audits and maintenance on systems such as Sales System, PMS and Profit Source system in conjunction with Sales Teams. Conduct routine GRC reviews with sales teams to include cleanup of stale pipeline, pricing review of active pipeline over needs periods.
* Group Pickup Tracking: Monitor and analyze contracted group blocks versus actualized/picked-up rooms. Identify underperforming groups early and collaborate with sales managers to mitigate wash. Communicate upcoming cut-off dates, to ensure timely entry of rooming lists and monitor potential inventory wash.
* Be knowledgeable of all special rates, promotions, room types, and hotel products.

**Position Requirements**

* Minimum of two years of revenue management experience, in NYC market preferably
* Multi-brand or multi-hotel experience
* Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing.
* Excellent in time management skills.
* Ability to investigate and analyze information and to draw conclusions.

**HHM Hotels Benefits and Perks**

* Medical, Dental and Vision Health Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* 401k Company Match
* Daily Pay
* Free Basic Life Insurance
* 24/7 access to TELUS Health, a confidential work-life resource.
* Travel Discounts
* Employee Assistance and Wellness Program
* Educational/Professional Development
* Referral Bonus Program

**Work Environment and Context**

* Work schedule varies and may include working varies shifts, holidays and weekends.
* Requires ability to navigate throughout the restaurant and kitchen, lifting up to 50 pounds, bending and reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

**What We Believe**

People Are Our Capability – Hearts That Serve – Only Excellence – Stay Nimble - Own It

About Us :

HHM Hotels is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, age, religion, disability, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other group protected by law.

jobs.title: Analyst – Sponsor and Franchise Portfolio Man
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This individual will primarily be responsible for the day-to-day management of the Franchise Finance portfolio of Mitsubishi HC Capital America, Inc. (MHCA), but will also assist with similar portfolio management activities on the Sponsor Finance portfolio. Daily activities will be centered on the monitoring and management of the portfolio including the preparation of credit underwriting memos in support of amendments and modifications of existing credit facilities. Key areas of focus will be the management of credit risk, the monitoring of compliance, preparation of internal reporting, and the maintenance and monitoring of borrower relationships. This position will collaborate closely with the underwriting and sales teams.

**Commitment to Internal Control:**

The incumbent must understand, abide, and uphold the system of internal controls related to the essential duties and responsibilities of the position.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Compile weekly and monthly portfolio reports for the Franchise Finance portfolio and for assigned transactions on the Sponsor Portfolio.
* Prepare trend cards as needed and aid in the preparation and presentation of the quarterly portfolio reviews on a quarterly basis or more frequently as needed. This includes financial covenant trend analysis, past financial performance analysis and performance to plan (vs. base case from underwriting) analysis.
* Update of financial projections and enterprise value analysis as needed.
* Proactively identify adverse client trends and take necessary steps toward positive resolution and minimize credit loss exposure.
* Determine appropriate risk rating for each borrower while ensuring timely rating changes as needed.
* Perform the necessary due diligence in the preparation of credit underwritings in support of amendments, modifications, and extensions for existing transactions.

* Make recommendation to the VP Senior Credit Officer, SVP - Chief Credit Officer – Specialty Finance, EVP – Chief Credit Officer, and other senior management regarding transactions for approval under local delegation, or for their recommendation for approval by International Credit Division of MHC/Tokyo. Presentation to local Credit Committee as required.

* Attend bank meetings in person or via teleconference as needed.
* Coordinate with agent banks to confirm covenant and financial reporting is in accordance with loan document requirements.
* Assist with the underwriting of new business as needed.
* Manage Salesforce records and information files.

**Management/Supervisory Responsibilities:**
============================================

* None.

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**
=================================================

* Credit assessment, structure, and transaction communication within company prepared guidelines.
* Control portfolio risk and mitigate loan loss to acceptable levels.

**Qualifications:**

*Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:*
===================================

* Basic experience with cash flow finance transactions (acquisition finance, LBOs), experience with Franchise Finance a plus.

* Basic understanding of structuring, underwriting, and documentation practices elated to senior secured cash flow loans.
* Basic knowledge of corporate finance principles, including financial statement analysis, projection analysis and financial cash flow modeling (three statement models).

* Familiarity with reporting and financial covenants for senior secured cash flow loans.
* Strong computer software skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Salesforce)
* Good interpersonal, organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Team player with positive attitude who understands role and how it relates to overall company success factors and keeps commitment to others.

* Time Management: ability to organize and manage multiple priorities and complete on a timely and accurate basis.
* Have a clear understanding of MHCA’s credit policies and operational procedures.

**Competencies:**
=================

  

* + Thinking skills
  + Analytical ability
  + Ability to synthesize
  + Problem-solving
* Communications
  + Ability to transmit information
  + Ability to listen
* Interpersonal Relationships
  + Ability to work in a Team
* Technical and Professional
  + Detail-oriented
  + Ability to work independently
* Personal Qualities
  + Action-oriented
  + Resilient
  + Adaptability
  + Self-starter
* Entrepreneurship
  + Business Acumen
  + Client-oriented

**Education and Experience:**
=============================

* BS in Accounting, Finance or Economics or equivalent experience.
* Formal credit training, with min. 1 year of experience in commercial lending, preferably in a portfolio management role.
* Alternatively, Masters Degree in Accounting or Finance with relevant internships in cash flow finance and portfolio management.

**Licensing and Certification:**

* Not applicable

**Tools and Equipment Used:**

* Personal computer, copier, phone, and other typical office equipment

**Working Hours:**

jobs.title: Analyst, FIU Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Coordinator to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will provide administrative and coordination support to the FIU. The FIU Coordinator will prepare and gather documents and information for Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other information requests; coordinate Requests for Information with internal and external stakeholders; maintain accurate records and tracking logs; monitor deadlines; and escalate delays, gaps, or other issues requiring attention. The role requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication, workload management, and the ability to work independently while following established procedures.

The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.

\*\*This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted until headcount is available. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate assigned FIU administrative requests and work items in accordance with established procedures, priorities, and deadlines.
* Prepare, gather, organize, and quality-check documents and information needed to support Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other FIU information requests.
* Coordinate Requests for Information with appropriate internal departments, program partners, financial institutions, and other stakeholders; communicate requirements and deadlines; and follow up on outstanding items.
* Maintain complete and accurate request files, correspondence, supporting documentation, status records, and tracking logs.
* Manage assigned workload, track due dates and dependencies, prioritize competing requests, and complete deliverables accurately and on time.
* Work independently within established procedures and promptly escalate missed deadlines, incomplete or conflicting information, unusual requests, or other issues requiring management attention.
* Provide timely status updates, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and help ensure requests move efficiently from intake through completion.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with appropriate care and in accordance with Bank requirements.
* Provide administrative support for FIU meetings, reporting, special projects, ad hoc tasks as needed, and other priorities, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deadlines in a structured and reliable manner.
* Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, exercise appropriate judgment, and escalate questions or issues when needed.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with the ability to create, organize, track, and maintain business records and correspondence.
* Strong time-management, prioritization, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate requests and communicate requirements, status, and follow-up needs effectively.
* Ability to collaborate effectively, handle confidential information with discretion, and recognize when matters should be escalated.

**Education, Training, and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Criminal Justice, Compliance, or a related field; or equivalent education and relevant work experience.
* Experience in an administrative, operations, coordination, records-management, legal-support, compliance-support, or similar role is preferred.
* Prior AML/BSA, financial crime, transaction monitoring, or investigative experience is not required; role-specific procedures and requirements will be provided through training.
* Experience using Microsoft Office products to organize information, maintain trackers, prepare documents, and manage business communications is preferred.
* Experience handling confidential or sensitive information and maintaining accurate records is preferred.
* Ability and willingness to learn FIU processes, Section 314(b) requests, subpoena-response procedures, Requests for Information, and related recordkeeping requirements.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better.

At **Hackensack Meridian** ***Health*** we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community.

Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The **Payroll Systems Analyst** is responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance/support of payroll systems activities associated with all aspects of payroll and time and attendance processing and systems and related systems/interfaces at Hackensack Meridian Health (HMH). Will work closely with Human Resources (HR), Information Technology (IT), medical center personnel throughout the Hackensack Meridian Health (HMH) network, vendors, and/or internal operations staff to design new or modify existing payroll information systems to meet changing requirements.

Responsibilities:

* Assist in business requirements gathering, accurately translating the needs to system functional requirements, and supporting IT in supporting the development projects.
* Provides/designs ad-hoc and standard payroll reports to clients.
* Acquires and retains in-depth knowledge of payroll and time and attendance system rules, table structure, and processing to effectively manage and resolve rule inconsistencies and incorrect calculations.
* Develop solutions to complex Payroll Systems situations/projects that require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity.
* Act as subject matter expert on Payroll implementation projects, documentation, design, change management, cost estimation, project management, testing, production support, and auditing.

* Minimum of 5+ years of experience including documentation, design, change management, cost estimation, project management, testing, production support, and auditing.
* Minimum of 5+ years of experience in report writing.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective knowledge of technological/automation theories, principles, and best practices.

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Intelligence Unit
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Analyst to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will be responsible for performing financial intelligence reviews involving potentially unusual or suspicious activity across the Bank’s products, customers, and partner programs. Under established procedures and appropriate guidance, the FIU Analyst will review alerts and referrals, analyze transactional activity and customer information, conduct relevant internal and external research, document findings, recommend appropriate dispositions, and escalate matters requiring further investigation or consideration. The FIU Analyst will contribute to timely, accurate, and consistent FIU reviews and documentation.

\*\*The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.

\*\*This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted on a continuous basis. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review assigned transaction monitoring alerts, internal or external referrals, and other FIU work items in accordance with established procedures and timelines.
* Review transactional activity, customer profiles, account history, prior investigations and filings, and relevant internal and external research to identify potential financial crime risk indicators and unusual patterns.
* Prepare clear, complete, and accurate review documentation and case narratives that summarize activity reviewed, research performed, findings, and rationale.
* Recommend alert or case dispositions based on available information and established guidance and promptly escalate potential suspicious activity or other matters requiring additional review.
* Manage assigned work items and priorities to meet review deadlines and quality expectations.
* Collaborate with FIU colleagues and seek guidance from experienced investigators or FIU leadership when questions or complex matters arise.
* Identify and communicate observed trends, recurring issues, and potential process concerns to FIU management.
* Develop knowledge of AML/BSA regulatory requirements, financial crime risks, enforcement trends, and relevant typologies through training and practical experience.
* Assist with special projects and other FIU priorities, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Ability and willingness to learn and apply AML/BSA requirements, financial crime concepts, suspicious activity monitoring processes, and SAR requirements through training and practical experience.
* Ability to review transactional and customer information, recognize relevant risk indicators or unusual patterns, and document findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to manage a deadline-driven workload while following established procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or related software; familiarity with transaction monitoring or case management systems is a plus.
* Analytical, organizational, research, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize research and findings in a concise, organized manner.
* Ability to follow procedures, work collaboratively, manage assigned tasks, and seek guidance when needed.

**Education, Training, and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field; or equivalent education and work experience.
* Entry-level position; prior professional experience in financial crimes compliance or investigations is not required. Relevant internship, coursework, or experience in banking, payments, fraud, compliance, investigations, data analysis, or research is preferred.
* No prior AML/BSA, financial crime, transaction monitoring, or investigative experience is required; role-specific knowledge will be provided through training.
* Interest in learning about banking operations, payment services, fintech partnerships, and the broader financial services ecosystem.
* Interest in pursuing a relevant professional certification, such as CAMS or CFE, is a plus but not required.
* Interest in developing knowledge of financial services industry risks, fraud and money laundering typologies, applicable regulations, fintech partnerships, and payment systems.

**About Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB)**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB) is a federally chartered bank founded in 2001 and headquartered in New York City. CFSB has focused on providing superior service and added value to clients though a solid understanding of relationship banking. We offer a full range of services, including loans, bill payments, card services, internet banking, and merchant processing.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military and/or veteran status, or any other Federal or State legally-protected classes.

jobs.description:
**Why Epicured?**

Epicured is on a mission to combat and prevent chronic disease, translating scientific research into high-quality food products for patients nationwide. Our evidence-based approach brings the best of the clinical and culinary worlds together to help people eat better, feel better, and live better one meal at a time.

**About Epicured**

Epicured helps prevent and manage chronic disease through medically tailored nutrition, combining clinical research with culinary expertise to improve health outcomes nationwide. Join a mission-driven team working at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology.

By joining our team, you’ll contribute to meaningful initiatives at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology — helping to improve access, reduce complexity, and directly impact the lives of people managing chronic health conditions.

**Position Overview**

Epicured is seeking a Culinary & Recipe Data Analyst to serve as a system manager and technical backbone for our recipe database in Galley. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end input, audit, and management of recipe data across all of our business lines.

Working directly with our Culinary Product Manager, you will follow established SOPs to ensure that every dish—from raw ingredient sourcing and vendor mapping to nutrition profiles and clinical allergen tags—is accurately modeled in Galley.

This is a critical role that directly unblocks our culinary backlog and optimizes product development. You will protect the integrity of our database architecture, support our cross-functional workflows, and have room to grow into broader product and data analysis responsibilities within the department.

**Responsibilities**

* Recipe Data Management - input, standardize, and maintain detailed recipe specifications across all business lines within the Galley platform according to company SOPs.
* Ingredient & Vendor Architecture - onboard and manage ingredients, map vendor supply data, and link accurate nutritional definitions and unit conversions.
* Attribute & Tagging Governance - apply and audit clinical, dietary, and operational attributes (e.g., Low FODMAP, Diabetes-Friendly, Cardiovascular, Active, Inactive) at both the sub-recipe and completed dish level to protect system integrity.
* Cross-Functional Data Quality - partner with culinary, clinical, and operation teams to audit existing recipes, correct discrepancies, and perform regular quality assurance checks on menu data.
* Process & System Support - identify operational bottlenecks in recipe data entry, assist in refining SOPs, and ensure data consistency to support downstream menu planning and rotation, nutrition review, and labeling outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Industry Experience: 2-3 years of food industry experience; whether through commercial kitchen/culinary experience, a background in food regulation, or work as a Registered Dietitian.
* Education: a degree in Food Science (preferred)
* Systems / Data Literacy: Proficiency in database entry or food management platforms (Galley experience is a huge plus, but other system experience is welcome).
* Eager to learn, adapt, and scale responsibilities within culinary operations / product development within the organization.
* Technical / Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for data manipulation, cross-referencing, and basic analysis.
* Meticulous approach to data integrity, numbers, unit conversions (yields, serving sizes, weights), and technical ingredient and recipe specifications

**Compensation & Benefits**

Pay: $70,000 - $85,000/year, based on experience

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Employee meal discounts

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

* Epicured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, creed, color, national origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

**How to Apply**

* Apply through the job board. Questions may be directed to careers@getepicured.com.

**Job Summary:**

The AI Data Analyst transforms business questions and complex data into trusted analyses, dashboards, predictive insights, and responsible AI-enabled solutions. This role combines analytics, reporting, visualization, and emerging AI technologies to improve operational efficiency and business performance. The ideal candidate is a recent Master’s graduate or early-career professional who is passionate about data, technology, and solving business challenges in a growing biopharmaceutical company.

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business leaders across functional areas to understand business objectives, identify opportunities for data-driven decision making, and translate business questions into actionable analytical solutions.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and risks that support operational, commercial, financial, and strategic initiatives across the organization.
* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools to provide meaningful insights to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Collect, cleanse, validate, and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analytics solutions.
* Utilize SQL, Python, and other analytical tools to perform ad hoc analyses, automate reporting processes, improve data accessibility, and support business performance monitoring.
* Support forecasting, trend analysis, scenario planning, and performance measurement initiatives by applying statistical and quantitative techniques to business data.
* Collaborate with Information Technology, Commercial, Market Access, Finance, Human Resources, Manufacturing, Quality, and other departments to support enterprise reporting and analytical initiatives.
* Assist in the evaluation, development, and implementation of artificial intelligence and automation solutions that improve efficiency, enhance decision making, and streamline business processes.
* Explore emerging technologies, advanced analytics methodologies, and AI tools to identify innovative opportunities that create measurable business value.
* Present analytical findings, recommendations, and business insights to technical and non-technical audiences through clear visualizations, executive summaries, and presentations.
* Participate in data governance, data quality, privacy, security, and compliance initiatives to ensure the integrity and responsible use of company information and AI-enabled solutions.
* Maintain documentation of data sources, methodologies, assumptions, and reporting processes to support transparency, consistency, and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred. Bachelor's degree with exceptional relevant experience will also be considered.
* Approximately 1 to 3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field. Relevant internships, co-ops, research projects, and graduate-level work may be considered toward experience requirements.
* Experience delivering analyses, dashboards, or data products that influence business decisions and are used by nontechnical stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics to practical business problems.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, or another regulated industry is preferred.

  

**This role is based in Warren, New Jersey, with work arrangements, travel expectations, and onsite requirements established based on business needs and company policy.**

**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

#### **What is the Developer Led Growth (DLG) Team?**

At the heart of our mission is a simple goal: to make choosing and integrating authentication a delightful experience for every developer.

We're the **DLG team**; essentially Product Led Growth (PLG), but for developers using Auth0. We're a high-impact, multidisciplinary engine spanning **Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, our Startup Program, and Product Activation and Conversion**. We move metrics and build the journey that turns curious developers into lifelong advocates.

#### **Why This Role?**

**This role sits within the DLG team as part of a two-person data team,** where you'll have an experienced tech lead as your analytical partner, giving you both the autonomy to own your domain and the support to go deep on hard problems. The DLG team moves fast across many fronts, and this role is the analytical voice that keeps everyone aligned on key metrics. That means your ability to communicate clearly, whether you're presenting to a VP, syncing with a data engineer, or writing a Slack message that makes a complex finding land, this matters as much as your technical skills.

**You'll have real autonomy and a clear voice in what gets built.** Requests come from every direction across the DLG org, and while your tech lead manages the overall roadmap, you'll have genuine input into prioritization decisions and the freedom to push back when scope isn't right. As you grow in the role, so does your ownership. This is a place where strong opinions and good judgment get rewarded.

**You'll ask questions nobody else is asking.** The best work on this team doesn't come from running the report that was requested, it comes from finding the insight nobody thought to look for. We want someone who is genuinely curious and brings creative thinking to how they frame problems.

**You'll work at the frontier of AI-assisted analytics.** We're a team that actively uses AI tooling to move faster and think bigger. We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier, in how you write SQL, explore data, prototype models, and document your work.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain **Tableau dashboards**, **Snowflake Streamlit** and **DBT models** that serve as the single source of truth for the DLG business
* Translate complex, cross-functional data into clear narratives and recommendations for stakeholders across product, marketing, sales, finance, and ops
* Proactively identify gaps, discrepancies, and opportunities in the data, and communicate findings in a way that drives action, not just awareness
* Own prioritization of your analytics roadmap: scope requests, push back when needed, and make transparent tradeoffs about where your time goes
* Analyze **A/B experiments** and DLG initiatives; design measurement frameworks that hold up to scrutiny
* Help the team automate and scale processes using **AI tools**, custom **SQL**, and creative approaches to reduce manual work
* Write clean, well-documented SQL and DBT models that others can build on

**What We're Looking For*****.***
---------------------------------

* **Communication and stakeholder management** - You can explain a complex data finding to a non-technical executive and a data engineer on the same day and land differently with each. You write clearly, listen well, and are comfortable pushing back when requirements aren't scoped correctly.
* **Prioritization** - You've operated in a high-demand environment where you couldn't do everything, and you have a clear framework for how you decide what matters. You can make your reasoning transparent and bring stakeholders along.
* **Creative thinking** - You approach analytics problems by first questioning whether you're solving the right problem. You've found insights that surprised the people who asked for the analysis.
* **AI proficiency** - You actively use AI tools (LLM assistants, code tools, automation) as part of your daily workflow and can speak concretely to how they've changed what you're able to produce.
* **Technical depth** - 5+ years in data analytics; strong SQL and data modeling skills; experience with DBT, Snowflake, Tableau, and Git preferred.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Python
* Developer-facing product experience
* Translating developer behavior into product insights
* A/B testing and experimentation design
* Revenue modeling and forecasting

**Job Title: GIS Analyst**

**Organization:** Port Authority of New York & New Jersey  
**Location:** Jersey City, NJ  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid, with preferred in-office attendance Tuesdays and Thursdays

**Position Overview**

The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey is seeking a hands-on **GIS Analyst** to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of geospatial applications, data, and systems.

The ideal candidate will have experience working within the Esri platform and be comfortable developing GIS applications, managing spatial data, supporting ArcGIS Enterprise environments, and automating common GIS workflows. This role will work closely with Engineering and business stakeholders to translate operational needs into practical, user-friendly GIS solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**GIS Application Development**

* Design, configure, develop, test, and maintain GIS-based web and mobile applications.
* Develop solutions using Esri tools including **ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, Experience Builder, Dashboards, Field Maps, and Survey123**.
* Configure web maps, applications, forms, dashboards, and user workflows to support Engineering and operational needs.
* Participate in the application lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Improve usability and user experience across GIS applications.

**GIS Data & Integration**

* Create, maintain, and manage spatial datasets, feature services, geodatabases, and related GIS content.
* Support integration of GIS data with other systems and data sources, including **CAD, BIM, asset management, and enterprise business systems**.
* Develop and maintain data conversion and ETL workflows.
* Perform data validation, quality assurance, and data cleanup.
* Support GIS data standards, governance, and documentation.

**GIS Automation**

* Develop scripts and tools to automate repetitive GIS and data-management processes.
* Use tools such as **Python, ArcPy, Arcade, ModelBuilder, REST APIs, or FME** as appropriate.
* Support automated data updates, synchronization, geoprocessing, and reporting workflows.

**GIS Platform Support**

* Support the administration, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades of ArcGIS Enterprise and related GIS infrastructure.
* Assist with migration of GIS applications, services, and data between development, test, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, data, and system issues and coordinate resolutions with internal technology teams.
* Document system configurations, workflows, applications, and technical changes.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Approximately 8-10+ **years of professional GIS experience**.
* **Hands-on GIS practitioner**
* Hands-on experience with **ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and/or ArcGIS Enterprise**.
* Demonstrated ability to create and configure Esri-based GIS applications.
* Experience developing web maps, dashboards, forms, or GIS applications using tools such as Experience Builder, Field Maps, Survey123, or similar Esri products.
* Experience working with geodatabases, feature services, spatial data, and GIS data management.
* Basic experience with GIS scripting, automation, or data-processing tools.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following experience is beneficial but **not required**:

* Experience with **Python, ArcPy, Arcade, ModelBuilder, REST APIs, or FME**.
* Experience integrating GIS with CAD, BIM, asset management, IoT, or other enterprise systems.
* Familiarity with **AutoCAD or Civil 3D** data and GIS/CAD interoperability.
* Experience supporting ArcGIS Enterprise environments and application migrations.
* Familiarity with cloud-hosted GIS environments such as Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with JavaScript or Esri ArcGIS APIs.
* Experience working in transportation, infrastructure, utilities, engineering, aviation, or port environments.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a **hands-on GIS practitioner** who enjoys building practical solutions and improving existing workflows. The role does not require a senior GIS architect or highly specialized software developer. We are looking for someone with a strong Esri foundation who can develop applications, work with data, automate processes, and continue expanding their technical capabilities while supporting real-world Engineering and infrastructure use cases.

Join one of our clients in the financial services sector as a Facilities Analyst, supporting approximately 20 retail bank branches throughout the Long Island and Huntington markets.

You will support the strategic and day-to-day management of facilities operations by analyzing facility performance, coordinating vendor services, monitoring budgets, supporting compliance initiatives, and identifying opportunities to improve workplace efficiency.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

We’re looking for you to join our team as a **Senior Principal Program Cost Control Analyst** based out of Chantilly, VA, McClellan CA or will consider remote for the right fit candidate. This position offers the 9/80 Schedule.

**What You’ll Get to Do**  
The **Senior Principal Program Cost Control Analyst (PCA)** will report to the department business manager within the Strategic Intelligence and Data Exploitation Operating unit.

The **PCA** will interface with the program managers, functional management, cost account managers (CAMs) and business managers to provide financial support and analysis to meet program requirements. They will prepare budgets and schedules for contract work and assist in financial analyses such as funding profiles, sales outlook, cash forecasting, and variance analysis.

The **PCA** will monitor costs and schedules on contracts requiring validated cost schedule control system. jobs.description:
Job Description

Amentum is seeking a Reliability Planning Analyst to support our team of multi-skilled technicians in a manufacturing, warehouse/distribution, and office environment.

The Reliability Planning Analyst, is responsible for the effective execution of all maintenance work controls processes. The primary role is to improve work force productivity and work quality by anticipating and eliminating potential delays through planning and coordination (scheduling) of labor, parts and material, tools and equipment, required permits, specialized documentation and equipment access. This position is empowered to manage work priority, develop job plans, define parts and materials, define crafts and skills, and engage the proper resources to develop a safe, effective and efficient work control plan.

Responsibilities:

Upholds safety, health, and environmental procedures; communicates directly; and supports the EHS policies to ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA and Company and Site-Specific rules and regulations always.

Acts as the principal liaison between the maintenance department and operation planning.

Maximizes resources by identifying parts, materials, special tools, external services, rentals and documentation by establishing, maintaining and improving the maintenance planning and scheduling flow and process tasks.

Receives and reviews all planned work orders from the requesting departments. Reviews and screens each work order to verify proper completion with all required information.

Examines planned work orders and determines scope and best practices to accomplish work.

Identifies work requiring engineering and design and reviews with proper entities.

Escalates issues to the Reliability Manager for work that requires special tools, personnel or special approvals.

Develops full scope and extent of work required, including cost and time required to conduct the relevant repair, preventive, predictive, and improvement maintenance activities of the plant equipment, buildings and grounds.

Prepares job plans for scheduling, detailing parts, materials, special tools and external services and documentation with planned costs. Job plans to include the sequencing of associated tasks.

Performs root cause analysis for continuous improvement.

Initiates and implements best practices with emphasis on planning/scheduling the preventive and predictive maintenance work.

Analyzes unplanned work orders and occurrences for incorporation into corrective and preventive actions.

Ensures that all maintenance personnel understand the work instructions using a procedures-based maintenance strategy and best practices for all maintenance tasks.

Ensures maintenance personnel update and close each work order when completed.

Prepares reports, collects and analyzes data, and makes recommendations for improving plant operations and solving maintenance and operations related problems.

Maximizes equipment reliability and availability through effective use of planned maintenance to quickly return equipment to design capacity and develops effective and applicable procedures to ensure defect free quality maintenance work.

Develops maintenance work schedule for affected areas including PM, PDM and Service Work Orders (SWOs).

Develops and adheres to prioritization of work tasks.

Performs post job reviews to ensure actual work performed and post repair operation is satisfactory.

Identifies and changes scope of PM or PDM (based on activity results) and SWO.

Maintains the CMMS while managing and tracking work orders, backlog, and spare parts and creates a machine history of plant equipment and reallocates resources as required.

Coordinates with Site Maintenance Manager and Operations to schedule workforce and resources for workforce and cost optimization.

Develops a system of planned job packages for recurring tasks.

Identifies, secures, and preplaces all parts and materials required to complete the work by providing stores with a Bill of Material for the work orders and kit of parts for maximum efficiency.

Creates a critical spares list and procures or identifies sources for procurement to reduce lead times.

Continuously improves, changes the job estimate, planning and scheduling process by utilizing feedback from maintenance team (PM optimization).

Maintains accurate metrics on the performance of planning and scheduling functions and provides information for continuous improvement.

Demonstrates a strong understanding of skilled crafts such as HVAC, Mechanics, Electrical, Pneumatics, Hydraulics, Plumbing, Pipe Fitting, Cranes, etc.

Tracks performance metrics such as schedule compliance, PM compliance, mean time between failure, planning maintenance vs. reactive maintenance, backlog, etc.

May be required to travel locally to other locations for support.

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or demonstrated equivalent combination of education and experience.

Two years of Facility Planning experience.

Must be U.S. Citizen or able to work without sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

Proficiency in a CMMS such as Maximo, SAP, or an equivalent program.

Preventive and/or Predictive maintenance planning experience.

Ability to coordinate parts and assign the appropriate skilled labor to ensure successful completion.

Ability to write processes and procedures related to facility maintenance work.

Practical experience with continuous improvement techniques such as Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, Six Sigma, 5S, Toyota Production Systems.

Demonstrated understanding of an effective safety culture.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.

Demonstrated skills in organization and time management.

Additional Information:

This position may require a valid state driver’s license.

This position will require the ability to obtain a security access badge at our client’s location.

jobs.description:
**About**

Bloomingdale's makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. Across all brand touchpoints, from Bloomingdales.com to our stores and emerging customer experiences, every colleague plays a critical role in bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture values innovation, collaboration, diverse perspectives, and customer-centered decision making.

**Job Overview**

Bloomingdale's is seeking a Director, Data Enablement & Analytics – Digital & Marketing to lead the strategy, governance, analytics, and measurement capabilities that support the Digital and Marketing organizations.

This leader is responsible for ensuring the business has the data foundations, measurement frameworks, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights needed to improve customer experiences, optimize marketing investments, and drive business growth. The role oversees both analytics delivery and the enablement capabilities required to scale decision-making, including data governance, KPI ownership, measurement standards, reporting frameworks, and data quality.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, analytical expertise, and strong business acumen. They are comfortable influencing senior leaders, defining long-term roadmaps, developing talent, and translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.

**Essential Functions**

* Define and lead the Digital and Marketing data, measurement, and analytics strategy, ensuring capabilities support enterprise objectives and customer growth priorities.
* Own the Digital and Marketing data foundation, including governance, KPI definitions, reporting standards, measurement methodologies, data quality, and platform enablement.
* Ensure the organization has the reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities necessary to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and guide investment decisions.
* Partner with Marketing, Digital, Loyalty, Technology, Finance, Data Science, and Macy's Inc. teams to advance measurement capabilities, analytical maturity, and data enablement priorities.
* Translate complex customer, digital, and marketing performance insights into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Establish scalable operating models, prioritization processes, and team structures that ensure successful delivery of analytics and enablement initiatives.
* Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team of analytics leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and business ownership.
* Champion adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, experimentation, and modern measurement practices that improve decision-making and business outcomes.

  

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Analytics, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, measurement, digital analytics, marketing analytics, or related disciplines.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and developing high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated success leading analytics and measurement functions within a complex, cross-functional organization.
* Experience influencing senior leaders and driving data-informed business decisions.
* Retail, ecommerce, digital, or customer-focused industry experience preferred.

**Leadership & Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of digital analytics, marketing measurement, customer behavior analytics, attribution, experimentation, and performance management.
* Experience establishing analytics operating models, governance frameworks, KPI definitions, reporting standards, and measurement methodologies.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to evaluate analytical approaches, challenge methodologies, guide technical teams, and partner effectively with Data Science, Engineering, and Technology organizations.
* Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, BI, and marketing technology ecosystems.
* Proven ability to translate analytical findings and technical concepts into strategic business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
* Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Invesco**
=================

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**What’s in it for you?**
=========================

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:

* Flexible paid time off
* Hybrid work schedule
* 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution
* Health & wellbeing benefits
* Parental Leave benefits
* Employee stock purchase plan

**Job Description**
===================

**Quantitative Analyst, Municipal Fixed Income**

**Your Team**

The Quantitative Analyst will be part of the broader quantitative team supporting Invesco Fixed Income. The team develops market research, data, models, and analytical tools that strengthen investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management. This role will focus on municipal strategies and work closely with portfolio managers and credit researchers on market, portfolio, and security-level questions. The analyst will also partner with quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to build reliable data and reusable analytical capabilities.

**Your Role**

As a Quantitative Analyst, you will combine municipal market knowledge, quantitative analysis, and practical implementation to support portfolio managers and credit researchers. You will identify and evaluate investment questions involving relative value, portfolio positioning, risk, performance, and market structure and build the tools needed to test and apply your ideas. You will have end-to-end responsibility for the municipal data supporting this work, from understanding source systems and resolving discrepancies to producing controlled analytical datasets. The role requires curiosity about markets and an interest in the daily work of turning data and investment ideas into reliable, useful analytics.

**You Will Be Responsible For:**

* Generating and evaluating quantitative investment ideas related to municipal relative value, portfolio positioning, performance drivers, and market opportunities.
* Measuring portfolio exposures on an absolute and benchmark-relative basis, including interest-rate, yield-curve, spread, credit, liquidity, and optionality risks.
* Developing scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess how market changes could affect performance, volatility, distributions, and portfolio positioning.
* Investigating differences between expected and realized performance, distinguishing market and economic drivers from data or model issues, and communicating findings to portfolio managers and credit researchers.
* Evaluating leverage and funding risks, including tender option bond and variable-rate municipal term preferred exposures and their implications for total return, liquidity, and distributions.
* Managing municipal data end to end, including acquisition, definitions, transformations, timing, lineage, quality controls, reconciliation, and availability across systems such as Perform and Aladdin.
* Building and maintaining analytical tools and automated workflows for holdings, transactions, pricing, benchmarks, risk, and performance while reducing routine manual processing.
* Partnering with investment, quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to test new ideas, implement useful analytics, and contribute reusable data, methods, and code to the broader platform.

**The Experience You Bring:**

* Experience applying quantitative analysis to fixed-income markets, relative value, portfolio risk, performance attribution, or portfolio construction.
* Knowledge of municipal securities, market conventions, portfolio structures, benchmarks, and sources of risk, or relevant fixed-income experience and a demonstrated ability to develop new market expertise.
* Demonstrated ability to formulate investment or analytical questions and build practical tools, models, or applications to evaluate them.
* Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, including experience working with complex datasets and automating analytical workflows.
* Experience investigating data from multiple systems, reconciling inconsistencies, establishing data-quality controls, and developing reliable analytical datasets.
* Familiarity with modern development practices and platforms such as Git or GitHub, cloud infrastructure, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable technologies.
* Experience using AI-assisted research or development tools to explore ideas, develop code, test analytical approaches, or improve productivity.
* Strong judgment and communication skills, including the ability to connect technical analysis to market developments, portfolio exposures, and practical investment decisions.

The salary range for this position in New York City is 145,000 - 158,000 USD/year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location

**Full Time / Part Time**
=========================

Full time

**Worker Type**
===============

Employee

**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
=========================

Yes

**Workplace Model**

jobs.description:
**ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:**

For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no-cost training programs in the most sought-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

**Per Scholas candidates must reside in one of the following states, provided the position does not carry a specific office location requirement:** AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA, WI.

  

**Position Title:** Instructional Assistant (Data Analytics)

**Location**: Bronx, NY

**Rate**: $23/hr

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

Per Scholas is seeking a dynamic, team-oriented individual to serve as an **Instructional Assistant (Data Analytics)** to join our ever-expanding organization. This person will join our Technical Instruction Training Team and be classified as a support instructor. The Instructional Assistant will play a vital role in our organization's mission, training Per Scholas learners to become outstanding entry to mid-level Data Analytics professionals.

### **Main Objectives**

* Provide effective instructional and technical support to the Lead Instructor in and out of training sessions.

* Provide effective technical guidance, tutoring, and lab support to learners in and out of training sessions.

* Display functional knowledge or the ability to quickly grasp core Data Analytics competencies, including:

* Spreadsheet Modeling & Advanced Excel
* SQL & Relational Databases
* Python or R for Data Analysis
* Data Visualization Tools (Tableau, Power BI)
* Fundamental Statistics & Data Storytelling

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

### **Lab & Classroom Responsibilities**

* **Curriculum & Lab Assistance:** Use the provided curriculum to assist the Lead Instructor in conducting technical training sessions tailored to prepare learners for entry-level Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or Data Reporting roles.
* **Learner & Code Support:** Monitor and assist a class of 15–36 learners via video conferencing or within the physical classroom/lab environment. Guide learners through debugging SQL queries, fixing Python syntax, and setting up visualization dashboards.
* **Study Groups & Tutoring:** Form and lead targeted study groups, office hours, and 1-on-1 tutoring sessions using instructor evaluations to support learners who are struggling or falling behind.
* **Lab Readiness & Troubleshooting:** Assist in gathering datasets, software tools, and code notebooks for daily lectures/labs. Troubleshoot issues with lab equipment, software, virtual environments, and audio/visual tools.
* **Schedule & Timekeeping:** Serve as a timekeeper to assist the Lead Instructor in managing schedules (e.g., class timers, lab windows, presentation slots, breaks).
* **Short-Term Coverage:** Understand the daily curriculum to conduct short lessons, review sessions, or lab walkthroughs if the Lead Instructor is out of the classroom.

### **Administrative Responsibilities**

* **Grading & Assessment:** Grade and review labs, coding assignments, quizzes, and capstone project deliverables.
* **LMS & Platform Management:** Utilize Canvas LMS to monitor learner grades, academic performance, and real-time lab submissions.
* **Data Entry & Attendance:** Take class attendance across platforms and maintain real-time learner data entry in software applications such as Salesforce.
* **Feedback & Meetings:** Review curriculum materials and report any errors to the curriculum development team. Participate in daily/weekly check-ins with the Lead Instructor, bi-weekly meetings with Management, and regular progress meetings with Career Advancement Coaches.
* **1-on-1 Learner Coaching:** Meet with learners 1-on-1 to discuss grades, attendance, and individualized study plans.

### **Growth Responsibilities**

* **Continuous Upskilling:** Utilize platforms such as Canvas LMS, Udemy, Coursera, and LinkedIn Learning to upskill in advanced analytics, data engineering, or machine learning tools.
* **Cross-Training & Professional Development:** Cross-train to support related tracks (such as IT Support, Networking, or Cyber) and occasionally deliver select lessons to prepare for future promotion opportunities.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

### **Technical & Educational Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:** Graduate of a Per Scholas Training Program (preferred) or relevant educational/work experience in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or Information Technology.
* **Core Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency or strong familiarity with SQL for database querying and data manipulation.
* Practical experience with Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas).
* Knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R for data analysis.
* Experience constructing interactive dashboards in Tableau or Power BI.

* **Bonus Qualifications (Optional):**

* Recommended by a Per Scholas Instructor or Staff Member.
* Certifications in Data Analytics (e.g., Google Data Analytics, CompTIA Data+, AWS Data Certified).
* Fundamental knowledge or experience in Cybersecurity, IT Support, or Networking.
* Certifications in Cybersecurity or IT

The Strategic Finance Analyst will be expected to present and discuss analysis to FP&A leaders. The analysis will be part of Finance’s ability to directly inform strategic decisions and support the firm’s profitability initiatives.

* Perform financial analysis to support capacity modeling and resource allocation at the subgroup, practice group and vertical levels.
* Contribute to the preparation of executive-level presentations and reports.
* Able to present and discuss analysis to Finance leadership.

Investment Management - Investment Operations

**A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE**

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

  

**What you will do**

In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting PGIM's Alternative Investment Operations platform, providing operational oversight across Asset Based Finance (ABF) and Residential Mortgage Whole Loan strategies. You'll support critical activities throughout the investment lifecycle , including deal onboarding, trade settlement, funding, asset servicing, and secondary market trading activities. The role requires extensive collaboration with Portfolio Management, Deal Teams, Legal, Fund Management, counterparties, custodians, trustees, and agent banks to ensure the accurate and timely execution of transactions and ongoing portfolio support.

This position is based in our office in Newark, NJ and will follow a hybrid schedule. * Coordinate and execute private asset transfers.
* Manage daily production including cash forecasting and positioning.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to research and resolve cash and position breaks.
* Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports to support business, operational, and management decision-making.
* Identify and implement process improvement and automation opportunities to increase operational efficiency, strengthen controls, and support business growth.

**What you will bring**

* Bachelors Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related discipline preferred. All majors considered.
* 3-5 years of experience in Financial Services
* Experience supporting Asset Based Finance, Residential Mortgage Loans, Private Credit, or Restructures
* Intermediate or Advanced skills with Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
* Ability to research issues, evaluate information, develop solutions, and escalate complex matters appropriately
* Strong work ethic, honesty and integrity, as well as strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a deadline driven environment

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience interpreting Credit Agreements and Purchase Agreements a plus
* Experience working with Transfer Agents a plus
* Experience settling Delayed Draw Term Loans (DDTL) and Revolvers and instructing/settling DWAC, DRS, FOP, and physical bonds or equities a plus
* Experience with Aladdin/Aladdin Loan Manager or other loan servicing platforms a plus

* **PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Note**: Prudential is required by state-specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $85,000 to $110,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills.

**What we offer you:**
======================

* **Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level.**
* **Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave.**
* 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%).
* Company-funded pension plan.
* **Wellness Programs** including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs.
* **Work/Life Resources** to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development.
* **Education Benefit** to help finance traditional college enrollment toward obtaining an approved degree and many accredited certificate programs.
* **Employee Stock Purchase Plan:** Shares can be purchased at 85% of the lower of two prices (Beginning or End of the purchase period).

Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. To find out more about our Total Rewards package, visit Work Life Balance | Prudential Careers. Some of the above benefits may not apply to part-time employees scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week.

jobs.title: AI Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
AI Operations | Managed AI Services | Full-Time, Exempt
  
ECI is seeking an AI Operations Analyst to serve as the operational front door for AI across its client base. This role helps clients adopt, operate, govern, and expand their use of approved enterprise AI platforms while ensuring each request is connected to the right technical guidance, governance path, and service engagement.
  
  
About ECI
  
ECI is building a dedicated AI Operations capability to help regulated organizations operate AI successfully and responsibly at scale. The AI Operations Analyst will work alongside engineers, governance specialists, adoption consultants, business development, and client-facing teams while helping shape ECI's managed AI operations discipline.
  
Position Summary
  
The AI Operations Analyst owns AI-related requests from intake through outcome confirmation, coordinating work across internal teams and maintaining clear client communication. The role combines technical support, client advisory, use-case discovery, governance awareness, and service coordination. Success requires understanding the business need behind each request, translating technical concepts into practical guidance, and engaging the appropriate specialists when broader value or deeper expertise is required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as the primary intake point for AI-related incidents, requests, advisory questions, changes, and operational needs, maintaining ownership through confirmed resolution or outcome.
* Classify, prioritize, document, and coordinate work through established service-management processes and provide proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational support for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, approved agents and connectors, and future approved AI platforms.
* Support licensing, entitlements, user access, group membership, troubleshooting, configuration validation, feature guidance, prompt assistance, and agent triage.
* Determine when a request can be resolved through a standard procedure and when AI Engineering, Security Operations, Infrastructure, AI Deployment, AI Adoption, AI Governance, or another specialist team should be engaged.
* Engage clients to understand the business objective behind technical requests and connect needs to relevant AI use cases, productivity goals, adoption requirements, and operational outcomes.
* Provide guidance on documented platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices, and participate in discovery discussions when technical context is needed.
* Recognize opportunities for AI Adoption, AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Deployment, managed AI services, or related project work, and introduce the appropriate ECI leader or delivery specialist.
* Identify data protection, responsible AI, security, compliance, shadow AI, prompt-injection, and data-exposure concerns and route them through the correct escalation process.
* Maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; track recurring support patterns and release impacts; and recommend automation, self-service, and service improvements.

Required Qualifications
  

* Three to seven years of experience in technical account management, customer success engineering, managed services operations, solutions engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, IT service delivery, SaaS support, or enterprise technical support.
* Demonstrated success in a client-facing technical role and experience using an IT service-management platform such as ServiceNow.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Copilot, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, licensing, single sign-on, SCIM, conditional access, and ITIL service-management concepts.
* Foundational understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, security, and operational risk.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language, uncover requirements through discovery conversations, and coordinate effectively across technical and client-facing teams.
* Excellent written communication, documentation, analytical, escalation-management, and knowledge-authoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience with Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Exposure to AI governance frameworks or responsible AI programs.
* Experience supporting financial services or another regulated industry.

ECI’s culture is all about connection - connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the base salary for this role is $125,000 plus flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! If you believe you’d be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever, we’d like to hear from you!!
  
Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!
  
ECI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration consistent with applicable law.

The New York City Mayor’s Office is responsible for overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs, coordinating public agencies and departments, and managing public property.
